basic_info.description:
Welcome to this fantastic investment opportunity in the coveted Corona Heights neighborhood of San Francisco. This three-unit building offers a prime location and excellent rental income potential.

Each unit is currently tenant occupied, providing immediate cash flow for the savvy investor. Renovated in 2014, the property consists of two 2-bed, 1-bath units and one 1-bed, 1-bath units. Behind a gated security door is a brand new in-building washer and dryer. A few more steps open up to a lush garden escape in the back with expansive views of the city.

Situated in the heart of Corona Heights, residents enjoy easy access to the vibrant Castro District, Duboce Triangle, and the Mission. Nearby Corona Heights Park offers stunning city views and a peaceful retreat from urban living.

This property presents an ideal opportunity for investors seeking a stable income stream in one of San Francisco's most desirable neighborhoods. Don't miss out on this chance to own a piece of San Francisco real estate.
